name: open-kioku
description: Your coding agent shows its evidence before it edits, and its diff is verified against the plan it declared. A local, read-only MCP server with 16 tools: code and regex search, symbol definitions and references, dependency paths, impact analysis, context packs, plan_change and verify_change, from an index under the repository's .ok/ directory. No hosted index or embeddings API required.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence before edits: local code intelligence for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Your coding agent shows its evidence before it edits, and its diff is verified against the plan it declared. 16 read-only MCP tools — code and regex search, symbol definitions and references, dependency paths, impact analysis, context packs, plan_change and verify_change — from a local Open Kioku index. No hosted index or embeddings API required.
